$comment: Red-team blocked-entry probes accept integers 0..50 (0 disables probes); an absent key defaults to 6, while invalid or unreadable settings disable probes. redTeamQueue.maxProbesPerTick operator override takes precedence over redTeam.queue.maxProbesPerTick here. Red-team queue floor: minimum concurrent starts when CPU idle meets the threshold. WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_MIN_CONCURRENT, WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_MIN_CONCURRENT_IDLE_PCT, and WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_REVIEW_STARTS_WHILE_IDLE override these values; file/env minimum concurrency and idle review starts are capped at 6; operator override minimum concurrency may reach 12.
